text: dsh-superpower 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的工程技能插件：它通过 SkillProvider 将 15 个流程技能加入 DSH 技能目录，并提供插件设置面板。用户可逐项启用或停用技能，也可让描述跟随宿主语言或固定为中文、英文；技能正文为英文。技能涵盖构思设计、计划、测试驱动开发、调试、并行 agent 和代码评审等流程，适合希望在 DSH 开发任务中使用结构化工程方法的用户。无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-superpower adds 15 workflow skills to the DSH Web client. A SkillProvider supplies per-skill toggles and bilingual descriptions that can follow the host language. English skill bodies cover design, planning, TDD, debugging, parallel agents, and review. No API key or external service is required.
我想让 DSH 在开始写新功能前先帮我梳理需求和设计。
有没有办法把一个多步骤开发需求拆成可以逐项执行和验证的计划？
我想在实现功能之前先写测试，按 TDD 的节奏推进。
代码出了异常，我该怎样先找到根因再修复？
我有几个互不依赖的任务，想交给多个 agent 并行处理。
收到代码评审意见后，怎么核实建议是否正确再决定是否修改？
我想在功能完成或合并前请人检查实现是否符合需求。
Can I get help coordinating independent implementation tasks and reviewing each result?
How can I keep a feature branch isolated from my current workspace while I work?
I need a checklist for verifying the work before I say it is complete.
dsh-superpower 的功能「構思设计」：提供关于在创意工作前澄清意图、需求并形成设计方案。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。
dsh-superpower 的功能「拆分实施计划」：提供关于把已明确的需求写成具体、分步且可验证的实施计划。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。
dsh-superpower 的功能「隔离工作区」：提供关于为需要隔离的开发任务检查并准备独立 worktree。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。
dsh-superpower 的功能「执行计划」：提供关于按既定计划逐项实施任务，并在当前会话中完成执行。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。
dsh-superpower 的功能「委派并评审子任务」：提供关于将独立任务分派给 implementer agent，并逐项进行规范与质量评审。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。
dsh-superpower 的功能「并行分发任务」：提供关于识别互相独立的工作并行委派给专门的 agent。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。
dsh-superpower 的功能「测试驱动开发」：提供关于在实现功能或修复缺陷前编写测试，并按失败、实现、通过的循环推进。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。
dsh-superpower 的功能「系统化调试」：提供关于遇到缺陷或异常时先调查根因，再提出修复方案。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。
dsh-superpower 的功能「发起代码评审」：提供关于在完成任务或重大功能后请求评审，以检查实现是否符合要求。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。
dsh-superpower 的功能「处理评审反馈」：提供关于核实代码评审意见的技术依据，再决定如何实施建议。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。
dsh-superpower 的功能「完成开发分支」：提供关于在实现和验证完成后决定如何集成分支，并按选择收尾。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。
dsh-superpower 的功能「完成前验证」：提供关于在声称工作完成前执行并确认验证命令的结果。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。
dsh-superpower 的功能「编写技能文档」：提供关于通过场景测试和迭代验证来创建、修改或检查技能文档。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。
dsh-superpower 的功能「查找适用技能」：提供关于在对话开始时查找可能适用的技能并按需调用。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。
dsh-superpower 的功能「分析会话问题」：提供关于为当前或历史会话收集带出处的证据并整理问题报告。在 DSH 技能目录中选择对应技能即可使用。

@wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · dsh-superpower：A DSH port of [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers). 15 skills are injected into `ctx.skills`. Skill bodies are the official English originals; the panel switches the description each skill shows in the model catalog and the slash-command (`/`) skill menu between Chinese and English, while skill names stay as upstream English.

@wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · What it is：A prescriptive engineering methodology: design first, slice the plan into verifiable steps, drive with tests, find the root cause before fixing, and run verification commands before claiming completion. It ships as a `dsh.bundle`, writes nothing into your home directory, uninstalls cleanly, and rebuilds itself through HMR.

@wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · What it is：Skill bodies are the upstream English originals (DSH-adapted: symbols, platform references, DSH-only sections). Each `SKILL.md` declares both an English `description` and a Chinese `description_zh`; the panel's language switch picks which one the model sees, without changing the body.

@wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · Skills：Tool mapping (Bash to pwsh, Read/Write to fs, and so on) lives in `skills/using-superpowers/references/dsh-tools.md`.

@wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · Same-name precedence：The official registry arbitrates same-layer name collisions by ascending `rank`. This bundle registers at rank 10, below `dsh-skill-filesystem` project and user roots (100-500) and official bundled skills (600). Whenever a same-name skill exists, this bundle's copy wins and the two rule sets never fight.
@wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · Skill switches and language：Open the `@wenaixi/dsh-superpower` card in the plugin manager; the panel sits at the bottom of its detail page.

@wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · Skill switches and language：- One switch per skill. Off means both sides lose it: the model no longer sees it in the available-skill catalog and `skill` tool calls are rejected; you can no longer reach it from slash-command completion or the CLI skill list.
- A 3-state segmented control (`中文 / English / 跟随宿主（自动）`) at the top of the panel switches the description language of all 15 skills at once. It changes only the `Superpower Skill:` text: the rest of the panel stays in the Host UI language and skill bodies stay English. Both descriptions carry the `Superpower Skill:` / `Superpower Skill：` prefix. When unset, descriptions follow the Host UI language (the language chosen in settings) and the control displays an indicator; picking `中文` or `English` locks the selection, and picking `跟随宿主（自动）` resets to following the Host. The choice is stored as a `language` preference in the profile (unset when following the Host).
- The panel header carries enable-all, disable-all, restore-defaults, and a search box.
- Changes take effect immediately; the running turn is unaffected and the next turn sees the new catalog and language.
- State lives in the profile's

text: @wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · Browser verification：Optional. Needs dsh and Python playwright installed locally. Both scripts take every address and path from the command line:

@wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · Browser verification：| Script | What it verifies |
|---|---|
| `scripts/browser/verify-switch-ui.py` | Real Web UI: open the plugin card, flip switches, click bulk buttons, search-filter, then read `cordis.patch.yml` back |
| `scripts/browser/verify-model-perception.py` | Four-phase loop: after a UI write, re-check both visibility sides through the Host's real `SkillRegistry` and compare UI rows against the Host catalog |

```bash
@wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · 1. Start a Web server on a profile that has this plugin; note the token in the startup log：dsh --profile <profile> --no-open --port 3199
section: 1. Start a Web server on a profile that has this plugin; note the token in the startup log

text:
@wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · 2. Full panel pass：python scripts/browser/verify-switch-ui.py \
  http://127.0.0.1:3199 <token> .verify-shots <profile>/cordis.patch.yml .verify-shots/expected.json

@wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · 3. UI and Host four-phase loop：python scripts/browser/verify-model-perception.py \
  http://127.0.0.1:3199 <token> <profile dir> <profile>/cordis.patch.yml .verify-shots
```

`expected.json` is the array of 15 skill names, used to assert that UI row order matches the `skills/` directory:

```bash
node -e "import('./lib/superpowers.js').then(async m=>{const c=await m.SkillCatalog.fromDirectory('skills');require('fs').writeFileSync('expected.json',JSON.stringify(c.verifyIntegrity().entries.map(e=>e.document.name)))})"
```
@wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · 3. UI and Host four-phase loop：Screenshots land in `.verify-shots/`, which is git-ignored.

@wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · FAQ：**404 after install, or wrong version?** Install from GitHub instead, or add `--registry https://registry.npmjs.org`. No allowlist is needed. Check the latest version with `npm view @wenaixi/dsh-superpower --registry https://registry.npmjs.org`.

@wenaixi/dsh-superpower README · FAQ：**Empty card title, description, or icon?** Usually `package.json`'s `exports` does not expose `./package.json` and `./locale/*.json`, or `icon` points at an absolute path outside the package. `node scripts/verify.mjs` asserts both, plus whether `files` ships the icon.
